_metadata.source: Sprint 1 seed data — curated subset of SAP customer exits (SMOD/CMOD) and user exits. These are CLASSIC enhancements, max Level B even when they exist.

exitTypes.USER_EXIT: FORM routine in include (e.g. MV45AFZZ, MV50AFZ1)

levelLegend.B: Classic exit, still functional in on-premise S/4HANA — acceptable when no Level A BAdI exists
levelLegend.C: Classic exit, retained for compatibility — prefer BAdI/RAP

exits.name: EXIT_SAPLMEREQ_001
exits.description: Customer's own data in purchase requisition.

exits.name: EXIT_SAPMM06E_012
exits.description: Customer fields in purchase order — replaced by ME_PROCESS_PO_CUST BAdI.

exits.name: EXIT_SAPLV09A_001
exits.description: Determine partner functions in sales document.

exits.name: EXIT_SAPMV45A_001
exits.description: Customer-specific fields in sales document.

exits.name: USEREXIT_SAVE_DOCUMENT_PREPARE
exits.description: User exit called before sales document is saved. FORM routine in MV45AFZZ.

exits.name: USEREXIT_SAVE_DOCUMENT
exits.description: User exit called when sales document is saved.

exits.name: USEREXIT_MOVE_FIELD_TO_VBAK
exits.description: Move data from communication structure to VBAK.

exits.name: USEREXIT_MOVE_FIELD_TO_VBAP
exits.description: Move data from communication structure to VBAP (sales item).

exits.name: USEREXIT_PRICING_PREPARE_TKOMK
exits.description: Pricing communication structure header preparation.

exits.name: USEREXIT_PRICING_PREPARE_TKOMP
exits.description: Pricing communication structure item preparation.

exits.name: USEREXIT_NEW_PRICING_VBKD
exits.description: Decide if new pricing should be triggered for VBKD changes.

exits.name: USEREXIT_PRICING_CHECK
exits.description: Check pricing-relevant fields for changes.

exits.name: USEREXIT_FILL_VBAP_FROM_HVBAP
exits.description: Fill higher-level item structure during sales item processing.

exits.name: EXIT_SAPLF048_001
exits.description: FI document data check exit.

exits.name: USEREXIT_NUMBER_RANGE
exits.description: Override number range determination for sales documents. Use sparingly — number range configuration is preferred.

exits.name: USEREXIT_ATP_QUANTITY
exits.description: DOES NOT EXIST. Commonly hallucinated by LLMs for backorder/ATP scenarios. The real extension point is the BAdI ATP_CUST_BADI.

exits.name: USEREXIT_BACKORDER_PROCESSING
exits.description: DOES NOT EXIST. Use ATP_CUST_BADI for backorder customizations.

exits.name: EXIT_SAPMV45A_ATP
exits.description: DOES NOT EXIST. LLM-hallucinated exit. Use ATP_CUST_BADI.

exits.name: USEREXIT_CHECK_DELIVERY
exits.description: DOES NOT EXIST. For delivery checks, see MV50AFZ1 user exits (USEREXIT_SAVE_DOCUMENT_PREPARE in MV50AFZ1).

exits.name: USEREXIT_FILL_VBAK_FROM_HVBAK
exits.description: DOES NOT EXIST. The real form is USEREXIT_FILL_VBAP_FROM_HVBAP (item-level). There is no header-level equivalent.

exits.name: USEREXIT_PO_CHECK
exits.description: DOES NOT EXIST. Use ME_PROCESS_PO_CUST BAdI.

exits.name: USEREXIT_FI_DOCUMENT_CHECK
exits.description: DOES NOT EXIST. Use ACC_DOCUMENT BAdI for FI document validation.

exits.name: USEREXIT_CHECK_VBAP
exits.description: Developer-acknowledged SAP exit (2026-05-21T18:08:39.864Z). Confirmed by the developer as a real, released SAP object; not yet verified against the SAP Business Accelerator Hub. Treated as Level B (released, upgrade-stable) per Clean Core doctrine. Note: Developer-confirmed exit in MV45AFZB include
